hero.title: Turkish to English translator

faq.heading: Frequently asked
faq.sub: Common questions about translating Turkish into English.

items.q: Can it handle Turkish's long suffixed words?
items.a: Yes — the whole word is read as the clause it represents, so tense, negation and questions built into the suffixes all appear in the English.

items.q: Do I need Turkish characters on my keyboard?
items.a: No. Speak the sentence or paste the message; ı, ğ, ş, ç, ö and ü come through exactly as written.
Yes. Record it and the English shows up a couple of seconds after the speaker finishes.
